integrity: The proof is reconstructed from the slice definitions, separates atomic and atomless slice witnesses, handles nonattainment of the maximal atomic mass by approximation, and is compared statement-by-statement with the cited primary literature. Novelty remains subject to unindexed equivalent terminology.
limitations: The theorem is proved for real sigma-finite L_1(mu); no extension to complex scalars, non-localizable measure spaces, or other Banach function spaces is claimed. The finite checker only tests algebraic inequalities.
title: Exact mixed-measure \(L_1\) Daugavet and Delta constants
